questions.prompt: Compare asexual and sexual reproduction, giving one advantage of each.
questions.modelAnswer: Asexual reproduction needs only one parent and no gametes; the offspring are identical clones. Advantage: it is fast and needs no partner, so good traits are copied exactly. Sexual reproduction involves the fusion of male and female gametes, usually from two parents, producing varied offspring. Advantage: variation increases the chance that some offspring survive disease or environmental change.
